narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of Linear Equations. In this chapter, we'll explore how to represent real-life situations using mathematical equations and solve them systematically. Get ready to explore the world of linear equations and build a strong foundation for higher mathematics!
